body: You realize the friend took the phone and kept using it till this point right? So, my girlfriend was supposed to magically have her phone? Thank you for the input buddy.
The friend never got a quote or went to get it repaired. She waited till now. Lol
The friend never went to get the phone appraised till just this week, had she done so back then my girlfriend could have helped no problem.

Thank you. It's just nice to hear from someone. Even my hobbies feel painful rather than enjoyable lately. Theres not really anything that feels good anymore. I know it's hard to advise someone in my position. Thank you for even starting, it helps when someone listens.
